Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The agent incorrectly concluded that Laura Osnes did not receive a Drama Desk Award based on a single search query that returned "No results found" for the specific site filter (`site:dramadesk.org`). This is a critical error in information retrieval logic: the absence of a result on one specific domain (especially when using a restrictive site filter) does not prove the fact is false. The agent failed to recognize that the official Drama Desk website might not list individual winners in a searchable index, or that the search syntax was too restrictive. Instead of broadening the search to include general web results or checking Wikipedia/Playbill (which were available in later steps), the agent prematurely asserted a negative fact ("she did not receive a Drama Desk Award") which directly contradicted the actual truth (she won for *Cinderella*). This mirrors the error pattern in Example 1 where an agent misinterprets "no result" or ambiguous data as definitive proof of a negative status, leading to an incorrect solution.
